title: Cave Point in October
why: Fall visitors who only know summer Cave Point; sells the quiet-season ride.
hook_options: Cave Point in October is a different park.
The Cave Point we wait all summer for.
caption: Summer Cave Point and October Cave Point are two different places. Same cliffs, same water, a fraction of the crowd. Ride 4.5 miles from our Jacksonport shop, park the bike and take the whole ledge. Who would you bring? #CavePoint #DoorCounty #QuietSeason #EBikeDoorCounty

slides.headline: Cave Point in October is a different park.
slides.body: Same cliffs. Same water. Way fewer people. Here's why fall might be the best time to ride out.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/May_26th_11am_Tour_1.JPG

slides.headline: Full lot. A crowd on every ledge.
slides.body: Summer Cave Point is beautiful, and everybody knows it. You wait your turn for the good rocks.

slides.headline: The waves, the cedars and you.
slides.body: Far fewer people. Park the bike, pick a ledge, stay as long as you want.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0610.JPG

slides.headline: 4.5 miles from our Jacksonport shop.
slides.body: Backroads and bike trails most of the way. Pedal assist takes care of the hills.

slides.headline: Bare trees mean more lake views.
slides.body: When the leaves drop you can see the water through the woods. Bonus scenery, no extra miles.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Ice castles ebike tour photos/ebike-tour-whitefish-bay-dunes-state-park.jpg

slides.headline: Take two hours. Sit a while.
slides.body: Two hours gives you time to ride out, sit on the rocks, eat something and ride back slow.

slides.headline: A windproof layer for the ledge.
slides.body: It's colder at the water than in the parking lot. Your future self will thank you.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_3678.PNG

slides.headline: Go midday.
slides.body: Warmest air, best light. The sun sets earlier every week from here.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0653.JPG

slides.headline: Fewer people. Same waves. Your pace.
slides.body: This is the Cave Point we wait all summer for.

slides.kicker: Save this for your fall trip
slides.headline: Come see it before the snow.
slides.body: E-bike rentals at doorcountykayaktours.com. Send this to whoever you'd ride with.
